add_friend_confirmation_dialog.title: Do you know this person?
add_friend_confirmation_dialog.message: Please only send friend requests to people you already know or have met during your travels — most people prefer to connect after meeting in person. <helpCenterLink>Read about friend requests in our Help Center.</helpCenterLink>
add_friend_confirmation_dialog.confirm: Yes, I know them. Send request!

block_user_confirmation_dialog.title: Are you sure you want to block {{name}}?
block_user_confirmation_dialog.message: Messages and requests from this person will be blocked, and your profile, events and comments will not be visible to this person. They will not be informed that you blocked them.

friend_request_no_longer_available: This friend request is no longer available.

remove_friend_confirmation_dialog.title: Remove friend
remove_friend_confirmation_dialog.message: Are you sure you want to remove {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

unblock_user_confirmation_dialog.title: Are you sure you want to unblock {{name}}?
unblock_user_confirmation_dialog.message: Unblocking will allow them to see your profile and send you requests. If you were previously friends, they will go back into your friends list. They will not be notified.
